tracks.title: Pronombre + Modal + Have Been + Verbo ING
tracks.formula: pronombre + modal + have + been + VERBO + ING + complemento
tracks.example: She must have been working.
tracks.bridge: Puente: must have been working = debió haber estado trabajando (modal + have + been + VERBO+ING).

tracks.title: Modal + Have + Participio
tracks.formula: modal + have + PARTICIPIO (should/could/must have + participio)
tracks.example: You should have studied more.
tracks.bridge: Puente: should have = debería haber + participio; could have = podría haber. NO es futuro perfecto (will have).

tracks.title: Clase 010 — WILL + HAVE + PP y BY
tracks.formula: BY + momento futuro + pronombre + will + have + PARTICIPIO
tracks.example: By Monday, I will have finished the report.
never: futuro simple will + base sin have
should have / could have / would have (eso pertenece a modal_have_pp)
will have + pasado en vez de participio
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-06
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 6 / Clase 010: WILL=RÉ, WOULD=RÍA y modal + verbo sin TO. Futuro perfecto = WILL + HAVE + PARTICIPIO; BY introduce el momento límite. I will have gone, nunca will have went.

tracks.title: Modulo 4 — BEEN + ING (perfecto continuo)
tracks.formula: HAVE/HAS/HAD + BEEN + VERBO-ING — BEEN activa el ING (ando/endo)
tracks.example: I have been working. She had been studying before the exam.
never: BEEN sin ING cuando la acción sigue
tracks.bridge: Puente Modulo 4 (BEEN): BEEN = participio de BE → activa ING. HAVE/HAS+BEEN+ING = he estado + ando/endo. HAD+BEEN+ING = había estado. Misma clase que HAVE+PP.

tracks.title: Have / Has / Had
tracks.formula: have. has. had. — paradigm con pausa
tracks.example: I have finished. / I had finished.
tracks.bridge: Puente: have/has/had — decir con pausa: have. has. had.

tracks.title: If I was / If I were / If I were to
tracks.formula: was = pasado real/posible | were = hipótesis irreal | were to = futuro poco probable
tracks.example: If I were rich, I would travel.
tracks.bridge: Puente: was = pasado real; were = hipótesis irreal (If I were…); were to = poco probable.

tracks.title: Verbos irregulares (Presente / PS / Participio)
tracks.formula: Col1 PRESENTE | Col2 PASADO | Col3 PARTICIPIO — decir con pausa: go. went. gone.
tracks.example: go. went. gone. / do. did. done. — NUNCA pegado
tracks.bridge: Puente: col1 presente / col2 pasado / col3 participio — siempre con pausa: go. went. gone.

tracks.title: There is / There are / To Have / Exist
tracks.formula: There is + 1 | There are + 2+ | Sujeto + have/has (posesión) | There exist(s) (formal)
tracks.example: There is a book on the table. / I have a book.
tracks.bridge: Puente: There is = hay (1); There are = hay (2+); have/has = posesión (no “hay”).

tracks.title: Clase 009 · Gerundio — TO BE + ING / TO vs ING
tracks.formula: TO BE + VERBO-ING = continuo | TO + VERBO = dirección/intención | VERBO-ING = concepto | preposición + VERBO-ING
tracks.example: I am working. / I want to work. / I enjoy working. / I am interested in learning.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-05
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 5 / Clase 009: TO BE = llave; ING = puerta; TO = flecha; ING = concepto; después de preposición, siempre ING.

tracks.title: Preposición + ING — siempre
tracks.formula: preposición + VERBO-ING — in/at/of/about/for + ING, siempre
tracks.example: I am interested in learning. / She is good at speaking English.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-05
tracks.bridge: Después de preposición → siempre ING (not TO). No es presente continuo (TO BE + ING).

tracks.title: Clase 011 — Preposiciones de tiempo (IN / ON / AT)
tracks.formula: IN = períodos largos | ON = días y fechas | AT = horas exactas | SINCE/FOR/DURING/BY
tracks.example: We meet on Monday in March at 5 pm. / I have worked here since 2020.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-07
aliases: prep de tiempo in on at
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 7 / Clase 011: mismos tres círculos — IN períodos; ON días/fechas; AT horas. SINCE=punto; FOR=duración; DURING=evento; BY=límite.

tracks.title: Clase 011 — IN / ON / AT + Preposiciones (Módulo 7)
tracks.formula: IN = adentro (grande) | ON = encima (mediano) | AT = punto exacto | resto por función
tracks.example: The book is on the table. / I am at home. / She walked into the room.
never: artículos a/an/the como foco de esta clase
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-07
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 7 / Clase 011: EN español hace los tres. IN=adentro (grande); ON=encima (mediano); AT=punto exacto. Tres círculos. Solo preposiciones — no artículos.

tracks.title: Negaciones - AUX + NOT
tracks.formula: pronombre + auxiliar + not + verbo + complemento
tracks.example: I do not work. / She doesn't go.
tracks.bridge: Puente: auxiliar + not + verbo base (I do not work — nunca “I no work”).

tracks.title: Comparativos
tracks.formula: adjetivo-er / more + adjetivo + than | the + adjetivo-est / most + adjetivo | as + adjetivo + as
tracks.example: She is taller than me.
tracks.bridge: Puente: -er/more + than = más… que; -est/most = el más…; as…as = tan…como.

tracks.title: Articulos a/an/the
tracks.formula: a/an (indefinido) | the (definido) | much/many/a lot of
tracks.example: I see a cat. / The cat is black.
tracks.bridge: Puente: a/an = uno/una (indefinido); the = el/la (definido).

tracks.title: Presente continuo · TO BE + ING
tracks.formula: TO BE (am/is/are/was/were) + VERBO-ING — acción en progreso
tracks.example: I am working. / They were eating. / She is studying now.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-05
tracks.bridge: Puente Presente continuo: TO BE (am/is/are) + VERBO-ING para acción en progreso. NO confundir con gerundio (TO vs ING / prep + ING).

tracks.title: Modulo 4 — Perfecto HAVE/HAS/HAD + BEEN+ING
tracks.formula: HAVE/HAS+PP · HAD+PP · HAVE/HAS+BEEN+ING · HAD+BEEN+ING — español HABER primero
tracks.example: I have gone. She has seen it. When I arrived she had left. I have been working here.
never: enseñar perfecto como pasado simple con ancla yesterday
I gone / she seen sin HAVE/HAS
BEEN sin ING cuando la acción sigue
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-04
tracks.bridge: Puente Modulo 4: español HABER+participio → HAVE/HAS+PP (afecta ahora) · HAD+PP (antes de otro pasado) · BEEN activa ING (sigue ahora). Piezas LEGO. Integra M1+M2+M3.

tracks.title: Modulo 3 — Pasado simple (16 verbos)
tracks.formula: En pasado nadie cambia · BE → was/were · ancla yesterday/last/ago · put/cut/let iguales
tracks.example: She went yesterday. They were here. I put my keys on the table last night.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-03
tracks.bridge: Puente Modulo 3: en pasado nadie cambia el verbo (alivio vs presente). Excepción BE: I/He/She/It → WAS; You/We/They → WERE. put/cut/let iguales — ancla dice el tiempo. Integra M1+M2.

tracks.title: Modulo 2 — Verbos presente + conjugacion
tracks.formula: TO = infinitivo · He/She/It + S · Go/Do → ES · Have → Has · Be → am/is/are
tracks.example: She goes. He does. It has. I go. We see them.
never: cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-02
tracks.bridge: Puente Modulo 2: pronombre solo no sirve — necesita verbo. TO = señal de infinitivo (desaparece al conjugar). He/She/It → +S; Go/Do → ES; Have → Has; Be → am/is/are. 16 verbos. Conecta con los 5 tipos de pronombres.

tracks.title: Clase 010 — WILL / WOULD y modales (Módulo 6)
tracks.formula: pronombre + modal + verbo base (sin TO) + complemento
tracks.example: I will go. / I would go. / She should study.
never: confundir would have / should have con este track
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-06
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 6 / Clase 010: WILL=RÉ (va a pasar de verdad); WOULD=RÍA (hipotético). Todos los modales van con verbo base sin TO. El sistema culmina en WILL + HAVE + PARTICIPIO, con BY como momento límite.

tracks.title: Clase 010-B — Confirmación modales espejo / even
tracks.formula: pedacitos will/would vs palabras completas should/could/must · modal izq=pregunta · der=afirmación · even=siquiera
tracks.example: Should she go? / She should go. / I shouldn't even go.
never: reinstalar will/ré desde cero (eso es module-06)
future perfect / would have antes de gate
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-06b
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 6-B: post-teoría — confirmar dominio. Pedacitos will/would (ré/ría) vs palabras completas should/could/must/may/might. Moneda modal (~90%): modal ANTES del pronombre = pregunta; DESPUÉS = afirmación. even + NOT = ni siquiera; even sin NOT = tan siquiera/at least. Have solo con participio. Prohibido modal+pasado.

tracks.title: Metodo moneda (inversion)
tracks.formula: verbo auxiliar ANTES del pronombre = pregunta | DESPUÉS del pronombre = respuesta
tracks.example: Are you coming? / You are coming.
tracks.bridge: Puente: método moneda — auxiliar ANTES del pronombre = pregunta; DESPUÉS = respuesta.

tracks.title: Clase 010 — WILL = RÉ (futuro real)
tracks.formula: pronombre + will + verbo base (sin TO) + complemento
tracks.example: I will call you tomorrow. / She will work on Monday.
never: convertir going to en el foco principal de la clase
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-06
tracks.bridge: Puente Módulo 6 / Clase 010: WILL=RÉ cuando va a pasar de verdad; WOULD=RÍA cuando es hipotético. Modal + verbo base sin TO. Going to puede nombrarse como plan, pero el foco es WILL/WOULD. Con WILL + HAVE + PARTICIPIO y BY se forma el futuro perfecto.

tracks.title: Los 5 tipos de pronombres
tracks.formula: Sujeto | Objeto | Posesivo Adj | Posesivo Pron | Reflexivo
tracks.example: She / Her / Her / Hers / Herself — We / Us / Our / Ours / Ourselves
never: enseñar solo I/you/he sin los 5 tipos
mezclar con tiempos verbales en esta lección
cortar o reescribir el guion canon module-01
tracks.bridge: Puente: 5 tipos — sujeto hace la acción; objeto recibe; pos.adj acompaña; pos.pron reemplaza; reflexivo vuelve al sujeto. Misma lógica ES↔EN.

tracks.title: Tiempos overview
tracks.formula: presente simple | pasado simple | presente continuo | presente perfecto | futuro
tracks.example: I work / I worked / I am working / I have worked
never: un solo tiempo como si fuera overview
tracks.bridge: Puente: PR=presente simple; PS=pasado simple; PC=presente continuo; PRP=presente perfecto.
